posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
Two problems here -

  1. You’re in /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_1 when instead you should be in ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_1
  2. You only need to do synchro init not synchro init BPT1_problem_1

Please read the README.md file present in the home directory thoroughly to avoid such misunderstandings in the future.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
Can you explain what were you trying to do with this?

All you need to do is -

cd ~/se2001/
mkdir BPT1_problem_2
cd BPT1_problem_2
synchro show
